events.title: Flash Flood near Yauco
events.description: 1 death. Yauco County. Rio Cotui went out of its banks, flooding portions of PR-372 in Yauco. A car was washed out with a male inside, the male was later found dead.

events.title: Flash Flood near Naguabo
events.description: 1 death. Naguabo County. A 24-year-old male was swept away from the waterfall pool known as Infinity Pool in El Yunque by a surge of water, fell from a height of 80 feet and died. He was with three other people who are safe.

events.title: Lightning near Villalba
events.description: 1 death. Villalba County. The 911 Call Center reported that at approximately 3:20 PM AST, a lightning strike impacted two individuals in a boat near the fishing club by the dam at Lago Toa Vaca. One individual was reported conscious with burns to the hands but breathing. The second individual, a 48 year old male, was thrown into the water by the impact; his body was found at around 8 PM ast.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Toa Baja
events.description: 1 death. Toa Baja County. The 911 call center reported a fallen tree in Parcelas San Jose on PR-8865, near PR-2 and Jose Nevarez Lopez Elementary School. The tree struck a vehicle, causing one fatality.

events.title: Flash Flood near San Juan
events.description: 1 death. San Juan County. The 911 Call Center reported that individuals were stranded in a Kia vehicle due to flash flooding from nearby streams along Camino Los Navarro in Barrio Quebrada Arenas, near Road PR-1 in San Juan. The floodwaters inundated the roadway, creating hazardous conditions and prompting a rescue response.

events.title: Flash Flood near Yabucoa
events.description: 1 death. Yabucoa County. Around 8:44 PM on November 16, 2024, a 63-year-old male and his passenger, a 39-year-old woman, crossed a low-level crossing/bridge in Barrio Guayabota, Sector Sasa, particularly on road 182 km 12. This bridge was covered with water as Guayanes River went over it due to the heavy rainfall activity that the municipality of Yabucoa was receiving. Radar estimates and observations suggested around 2 to 4 inches of rain in the area of the incident and around 6 inches across the municipality. As they crossed the bridge, the Ford F-150 that they were in got dragged into the fast-flowing river.…

events.title: Flash Flood near San Sebastian
events.description: 1 death. San Sebastian County. A person was swept away as Cascada Gozalandia, while other two were trapped by increasing water levels in Rio Guatemala. The body of the person was found and recovered two days later, when the water levels finally receded.

events.title: Flash Flood near Juncos
events.description: 1 death. Juncos County. Emergency managers found the body of a 47-year-old woman who was swept away by the flash floods of Quebrada la Ceiba from the bridge on the road PR-31 on Saturday, November 5th.

events.title: Flash Flood near Comerio
events.description: 1 death. Comerio County. A report in the local media indicated that a 58-year-old man fell from the roof of his house and was swept away by flooding waters into a tributary of Rio La Plata in Comerio.

events.title: Flash Flood near Toa Baja
events.description: 1 death. Toa Baja County. A report in the newspaper indicated that a 62-year-old male was swept away by flooding rain at La Virgencita, Toa Baja. The male was swept away from inside his car and the body was recovered three days later.

events.title: Lightning near Salinas
events.description: 2 deaths. Salinas County. Lightning struck a jetski in Cayo Matias, just south of Salinas. There were two fatalities and a third person was taken to a hospital. A marine weather statement due to thunderstorms was in effect for nearby waters.

events.title: Flash Flood near Arecibo
events.description: 1 death. Arecibo County. A man died due to flash flooding in an unnamed small creek in Sector Las Canelas between Arecibo y Hatillo.

events.title: Flash Flood near Rincon
events.description: 1 death. Rincon County. A woman in her 50s was swept away while inside her vehicle by a small stream located on Road PR-411 KM 0.1. Woman was found dead a few days after.

events.title: Flood near Ponce
events.description: 1 death. Ponce County. A 24 year old woman drowned after being swept away due to a water surge along the Portuguese River in Barrio Tibes near road PR-10.

events.title: Flood near San Sebastian
events.description: 1 death. San Sebastian County. A 56 year old man was dragged by a surge of water on the Guatemala river. PREMA search and rescue team found the body down river.

events.title: Flash Flood near Toa Baja
events.description: 9 deaths. Toa Baja County. Rio de la Plata went out of its banks producing catastrophic flooding across Toa Baja municipality. Nine people were confirmed dead due to flooding water associated with the river.

events.title: Flash Flood near Vega Alta
events.description: 1 death. Vega Alta County. Rio de la Plata went out of its banks. One person was confirmed dead when he was trying to cross road PR-690 in bicycle.

events.title: Flash Flood near Arecibo
events.description: 1 death. Arecibo County. Rio Grande de Arecibo went out of its banks. One person was found dead, when he drowned due the flooding water of Rio Grande de Arecibo.

events.title: Flash Flood near Aguada
events.description: 2 deaths. Aguada County. Rio Culebrinas was out of its banks, flooding most of the Coloso area and its surrounding areas. Two police officer died when a surge of water swept then when Rio Culebrinas went out of its banks.

events.title: Flash Flood near Anasco
events.description: 4 deaths. Anasco County. Heavy rain resulted in flash flooding across the municipality of Anasco. Rio Anasco and all its tributaries went out of its banks. Four people were confirmed dead due to the flooding waters associated with the river.

events.title: Flash Flood near Utuado
events.description: 3 deaths. Utuado County. Catastrophic flash flooding occurred along Rio Grande de Arecibo in the municipality of Utuado. Serious mudslides occurred across the municipality, were many bridges were totally destroyed, leaving most communities were isolated from getting food, gas and goods supplies. Three sisters were confirmed dead at San Miguel sector when a mudslide destroy their house.

events.title: Lightning near Juana Diaz
events.description: 1 death. Juana Diaz County. A 63-yr old fisherman died by a lightning strike. The man anchored his boat on the beach in Barrio Capitanejo at Juana Diaz, when a lightning struck on the water.

events.title: Flash Flood near San Sebastian
events.description: 1 death. San Sebastian County. Two minors were swept away by flood waters of Rio Saltillos in Barrio Eneas in San Sebastian.
